name: Kodak Professional T-MAX 100 (100TMX)
notes: Characteristic curves: x axis is absolute log exposure in lux-seconds, as printed; the plots say 'Exposure: Daylight'. No Log H Ref is printed.

curves/v is the sheet's first plot, D-76 small tank at 20 C, 6 min (long-dash curve). The processing table (page 3) gives 6 1/2 min for D-76 in a small tank at 68 F, so 6 min is the nearest plotted time (contrast index just under the 0.56 where the contrast-index charts start). Same plot: v-d76-7.5 and v-d76-10.

Further plots, one plot per panel of page 8: 'curves-tmax' = KODAK T-MAX Developer, small tank, 20 C, 6/7/10/12 min (v-tmax-6, -7, -10, -12; the table's T-MAX 1:4 time is 7 1/2 min at 68 F; this panel's density axis stops at 3.0 so the 12 min curve leaves the plot at about log H 0.39); 'curves-tmaxrs' = T-MAX RS Developer and Replenisher, large tank, 20 C, 8/10.5/13/15 min (v-tmaxrs-8, -10.5, -13, -15; table 8 3/4 min).

Spectral sensitivity: effective exposure 1.4 s, Developer D-76 68 F, diffuse visual; sensitivity/v is the curve '1.0 greater than D-min', v-d03 is '0.3 greater than D-min'. Log sensitivity = reciprocal of exposure (ergs/cm2) as printed; the axis labels use bar notation, so 1-bar.0 and 2-bar.0 are read as -1.0 and -2.0. The curves start at 400 nm.

Grain: diffuse rms granularity 8, read at net diffuse density 1.00 with a 48 micrometre aperture, 12x, development in D-76 at 68 F (IMAGE STRUCTURE section). Resolving power 63 lines/mm (TOC 1.6:1) and 200 lines/mm (TOC 1000:1).
Push: the sheet gives EI 200 (1-stop, normal processing), EI 400 (2-stop) and EI 800 (3-stop) pushes in T-MAX / T-MAX RS developer; no curves are plotted for them.
